'''Savastorol Hennig Denn''', formally styled as '''His Excellency Lord Savastorol Hennig Denn''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:LDSHtPP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Lord Denn Seeks Hunters to Protect Party}}</ref>
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Savastorol Hennig Denn was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LDSHtPP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
